headlines.title: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted 2 Houthi ballistic missiles headed for southwestern Saudi Arabia
headlines.snippet: The Saudi-led coalition stated it intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at southwestern Saudi Arabia. Danger alerts were issued and later lifted in Riyadh, Abha, and Khamis Mushait.

headlines.title: Belgium condemns attack by Israeli occupiers on Palestinians, diplomats in West Bank
headlines.snippet: Belgium condemned an attack by Israeli occupiers on Palestinians and diplomats in the West Bank. The foreign minister confirmed the safety of the Belgian team and pledged continued efforts for EU sanctions.

headlines.title: Houthis claim to have shot down Saudi Apache helicopter near Yemen border
headlines.snippet: The Houthi military spokesperson claimed they shot down a Saudi Apache helicopter near the Yemen border, stating it was conducting 'hostile operations.'

headlines.title: Turkish foreign minister praises Iraqi premier's 'strong vision' for advancing bilateral ties with Ankara
headlines.snippet: The Turkish foreign minister praised the Iraqi prime minister's 'strong vision' for enhancing bilateral ties with Ankara, discussing energy, security, counterterrorism, and the Development Road Project.

headlines.title: US envoy urges Israel to punish settler terrorism against journalist
headlines.snippet: U.S. Ambassador Mike Huckabee condemned an attack by illegal Israeli settlers on a Washington Post photographer as an 'an act of terror' and demanded accountability.

headlines.title: Turkish Embassy rejects reports of FM Fidan's 'secret talks' in Baku
headlines.snippet: Türkiye's Embassy in Baku rejected reports alleging that Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan held a secret meeting in Azerbaijan.

headlines.title: Meta revises terms amid concerns over AI training on news content
headlines.snippet: Meta has revised its terms to address concerns regarding the use of news publishers' websites for training artificial intelligence models.

headlines.title: Lebanon to participate in US-led trilateral talks with Israel: Aoun
headlines.snippet: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun announced that Lebanon and Israel will participate in US-backed trilateral talks in Tampa, Florida, on October 20.

headlines.title: Zelenskyy warns Trump sanctions waiver risks fueling Russian aggression
headlines.snippet: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that US President Donald Trump's waiver of impending sanctions on Russia would embolden Moscow.
